biography:
From textile science
to the production floor.

I’m Ariful Islam Fahim, a final-year student at Green University of Bangladesh, specializing in Apparel Manufacturing. My work brings together textile testing, wet-processing fundamentals, and an interest in how production and quality decisions shape the finished product.

I’m seeking internship or trainee opportunities in apparel manufacturing, production operations, quality assurance, or textile processing. Alongside engineering, I’m developing arif4you to make technology and practical AI easier to understand.
